name: Hoarfrost
primary:
Biting frost that chills, hurts and grips everyone in the zone, leaving no ice.
A zone at the aim point with a 4-block radius for 8 s. Every second, on everyone inside except you:
• Damage 1.25 ❤ cold
• Cold 35: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
• Rooted in place for 1 s
